title: Reduce macOS pointer latency under system load
description: Migrate issue tracking from the empty bd/Dolt scaffold to br. Remove the per-tick display geometry query from relative mouse movement without caching cursor position, add low-overhead performer latency metrics, quiet hot INFO logs, and verify the installed daemon under load.
acceptance_criteria: Relative cursor movement remains smooth under load; cursor position is read live rather than cached; PADJUTSU_METRICS exposes queue and execution latency; default logs do not grow at tick rate; crate tests, clippy, and release build pass.
notes: Verified live on macOS at load averages 68-121. Performer queue wait p99 approximately 50us, mouse post p99 0.25-0.5ms, queue_len=0, max_batch=2-3; 15-second sample showed no SLSGetDisplayBounds in the movement hot path. Scoped Clippy passed; padjutsu-control 15/15 and padjutsud 38/38 tests passed; signed release installed. Added just measure-latency for repeatable measurement.
close_reason: Completed: live stress measurement passed, signed release installed, diagnostics command verified.

title: Add production jerk diagnostics
description: Keep low-overhead metrics enabled in release builds and distinguish pointer jerks caused by scheduler stalls, performer queueing/coalescing, large output deltas, irregular post cadence, or slow CGEvent posting.
acceptance_criteria: Production mode reports at a configurable low frequency; tick and mouse-post histograms expose p95/p99/max, missed periods, coalescing and large deltas; anomaly counters do not spam logs; release build and scoped tests pass; live daemon is verified.
notes: Implemented default-on 60s production metrics for SDL loop gaps/drops/broadcast cost, wake deadline lateness, stick tick cadence/execution/missed periods, performer queue wait/coalescing/deltas/input age, CGEvent post latency with >4/>16/>50ms counters, and cursor tracking error. Live diagnostics found and fixed stale tick dt after idle/deadzone (pre-fix max 91.686ms; post-fix nominal 8ms resume). A live loaded run then isolated a rare 86.068ms mouse post stall that backed up the performer queue; subsequent verification showed no >16ms mouse posts, zero queue waits >4ms, zero drops, wake p99 <=250us, and explicit anomaly counters. Release installed/codesigned and launchd PID verified. Scoped tests and clippy passed. Install now uses --locked; measurement tolerates unavailable macOS sample.
close_reason: Production jerk diagnostics implemented, live-validated, and installed
